name: Butler Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a modern multi-story residence with a dark roof located on one portion of the lot|A paved driveway and parking area serve the house|An additional unpaved drive connects the street with the rear of the residence|A large open dirt area with construction equipment and materials occupies the adjacent section of the site|Landscaped trees and shrubs border the street and portions of the completed structure|The residence appears recently constructed.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a modern multi-story home with a dark roof and contemporary exterior|A paved driveway leads to the garage and front entry|An unpaved drive connects the street to the back of the residence|Landscaped areas with trees and shrubs line the street frontage|An open construction zone with equipment and cleared ground is visible adjacent to the completed house.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side of the modern multi-story home|A paved driveway and parking area are present near the structure|Landscaped plantings and trees run along the property edge|The adjacent open dirt area with construction activity is visible from this angle.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the modern home with a dark roof|A small green lawn area is present near the structure|The large open construction zone with equipment and cleared ground extends across the adjacent portion of the lot|Trees and landscaping border parts of the site.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the modern multi-story home and the paved driveway|An unpaved drive connects the street with the back of the residence|Landscaped areas and trees are present along the street|The open dirt construction area with heavy equipment occupies a significant portion of the lot adjacent to the completed structure.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway leading from Crenshaw Road to the front of the residence and garage. An unpaved drive connects the street with the rear of the residence. The completed house has clear street frontage and open access. A large active construction zone with equipment, materials, and cleared ground occupies the adjacent portion of the property and may affect movement and staging in that area. Landscaped trees and shrubs are present along the street and property edges.The residence is near the street with direct access from it.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? What is the status and planned use of the open construction area adjacent to the house? Are there any temporary access restrictions or hazards related to the ongoing site work?
